**Short Answer:** **No, not with the naked eye during bright daylight.**

- The **Sun is below the horizon** (i.e., at night)
- The **Moon is above the horizon** and **not too close to the Sun** (i.e., not a new Moon)
- The **sky is dark enough** (i.e., not bright daylight)
